rationale: R13 (rust extreme review): rust emitted NO declared-type references at all (only where-bounds) — the one family-standard surface it lacked. Parameter types, return types, struct field types, enum variant field types (tuple and struct forms), const types and alias right-hand sides each emit `references` to every named type mentioned (generic outer AND inner leaves; primitives never appear since they are primitive_type nodes, not type_identifier). `Self` resolves to the enclosing impl type (D2 rule) and is otherwise skipped — a bare Self edge could never resolve. Generic parameter names are locally bound, never deps (the R8 forbid on generic->T in bare-value-reads guards the same name from the other side).

expectRelationships.comment: Self resolved to the enclosing impl type

forbidRelationships.comment: primitives are primitive_type nodes, never type_identifier leaves
